SECTION 23 / CORE SYLLABUS
03. JWT Structure and Signature

SIMPLE ENGLISH
A commonly used signed JWT has a header, payload and signature. The signature protects
integrity, not secrecy.
සිංහJලෙන් JWT එJකේ header එJකේ algorithm metadata, payload එJකේ claims, signature එJකේ integrity
check තිJයනවා. Payload එක කියවිය හැකියි; password දාන්න එපා.
An API receives a signed token with user ID and expiry.

VISUAL MODEL · Header Payload: sub, exp Signature · Verify before trust · Read the diagram: Header → Payload: sub, exp → Signature → Verify before trust. JWT එJකේ header එJකේ · algorithm metadata, payload එJකේ claims, signature එJකේ integrity check තිJයනවා. Payload එක කියවිය හැකියි; · password දාන්න එපා.
Expected result: Valid signature and configured claims pass; invalid token is rejected.
Is a signed JWT encrypted? No. Its encoded claims are readable.
